items.information:
(BR) Bem-vindos à primeira competição oficial em Rio do Sul!
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_
Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) 
**Inscrições no local da competição serão aceitas somente para o evento 3x3x3.**

(EN) Welcome to the first official competition in Rio do Sul!
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_
Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)
**On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event.**

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be emailed to registered comeptitors

items.information:
**This competition is not recommended for first-timers or those looking for a typical competition experience.** This will be a small competition with a selection of uncommon events. We will not be holding typical events like 3x3 and Pyraminx.

This competition will be held outdoors and will be weather permitting. We advise against booking any non-refundable travel accommodations in case the competition needs to be cancelled due to inclement weather.

There will not be total silence for blindfolded events, but there will be pleasant nature sounds.

At most one guest per competitor is permitted. Lunch and dinner for all competitors and guests is included in the registration fee. Please let us know in the registration comments if you have any dietary restrictions.

items.name: CubingUSA New England Quiet Championship 2024
items.information:
This competition is part of the [CubingUSA New England Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewEnglandChampionship2024)! Podium winners and champions of each events will be recognized at the main competition, two weeks later in Providence.

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 Blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later.

items.information:
### Chào mừng đến với Blind Till Nine in Vietnam 2024.
Giải đấu duy nhất tập trung các bộ môn Im Lặng (Please Be Quiet) trong năm 2024 tại Việt Nam.
Giải đấu chỉ bao gồm các môn: giải Bịt mắt - BLD, giải Tối ưu - FMC và giải Đồng hồ - Clock.

**Nếu muốn tham gia các bộ môn liên quan đến giải Tốc độ, các bạn có thể tham khảo giải Hanoi COP Open 2024 vào ngày chủ nhật (11/08).**

Đừng vội vã, chúng ta sẽ BLD đến 9 giờ tối!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2lEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5241800b4bcd4aa25a504edf5f950bbca6a2fe90/Logo%20comp.png)

### Welcome to Blind Till Nine in Vietnam 2024.
Your only PBQ-styled WCA competition in Vietnam this year 2024!.
This competition features only Blindfolded, Fewest Moves and Clock events.

**If you are coming for Speed events, please refer to Hanoi COP Open 2024 on Sunday, instead.**

Don't rush, we will just blind till nine!
